prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star desktop web portfolio comp, first viewport, landscape 16:9
Primary request: Design the category-standard premium portfolio for Costa Maskulov, a bilingual creative full-stack developer. Execute the familiar portfolio structure impeccably without experimental metaphors.
Structure: clean top navigation with identity, Projets, À propos, FR / EN. Large direct hero headline and concise supporting copy on the left. One large SideQuest project preview on the right, explicitly labeled as a fictitious unbuilt application. Primary CTA to projects and secondary action to about. Visible technical tags and clean transition into the projects section below the fold.
Visual system: refined editorial grid, generous whitespace, cream main background, restrained violet brand field, lime primary CTA, tiny pink accent, near-black text. Premium spacing, strong alignment, excellent hierarchy and clear interactive states.
Typography: expressive condensed display for the hero, highly legible modern sans-serif for interface and body, restrained italic serif accent.
Text (verbatim): "COSTA MASKULOV"; "DÉVELOPPEUR FULL-STACK CRÉATIF"; "JE CONÇOIS DES EXPÉRIENCES WEB SINGULIÈRES, ACCESSIBLES ET SOLIDES."; "VOIR LES PROJETS"; "À PROPOS"; "SIDEQUEST"; "MOCK FICTIF — APPLICATION NON RÉALISÉE"; "UX/UI"; "FRONTEND"; "BACKEND"; "FR / EN".
Color palette: #F5F1E8 #101113 #4B3CFF #C7FF00 #FF6BD6.
Constraints: highly readable and recruiter-friendly, SideQuest unmistakably a mock, WCAG-minded contrast, visible controls, no fake claims. Distinct craft through proportion and type, not effects.
Avoid: generic SaaS, Bento dashboard, excessive stickers, gradients, glassmorphism, custom cursor, cyberpunk, illegible display text, photoreal people, device mockup, watermark.
